meta.title: Location — Registering And Looking Up Location
meta.subtitle: Server registers descriptor and owner in the Store · Client reads the location and sends the message directly

cards.title: Location Store (infra)
items: The Object Server registers its own descriptor and current owner in the Location Store.
The Object Client reads the current location from the Location Store and picks the target MeshNode.
The Store is used only to find location — the actual application message is sent directly to the selected MeshNode.
